backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining Task, TaskContent, AdsMetrics, and Milestone types with CRUD operations for tasks (add, edit, complete, addNotes), milestone progress updates, and ads metrics management using stable Map storage.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that upgrades actor state from OldActor (tasks, adsMetrics, nextTaskId) to NewActor by adding an empty milestones Map while preserving existing data.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting five high-confidence features for removing checkbox-based progress tracking and implementing manual slider-based milestone progress control across frontend components and backend integration.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of 18 frontend files describing the React/TypeScript application structure with TanStack Router, manual milestone progress sliders, phase-based navigation, and backend integration via React Query hooks.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light and dark theme variables including six phase-specific colors (phase-1 through phase-6) for milestone visualization.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with Spanish title 'Dashboard de Plan de 90 Días' that mounts the React application at #root div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with two routes: main dashboard (/) and ADS dashboard (/ads), both wrapped in Layout component.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Layout wrapper component with header showing app title, navigation tabs for Plan de 90 Días and Dashboard ADS, main content outlet, and footer with caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/MilestoneSection: Displays a collapsible milestone card with progress slider, task count, description, and deliverables. Allows manual progress updates via slider and shows associated tasks when expanded.
Shows overall project progress as a percentage and progress bar, calculating completion based on all milestones. Displays count of completed vs total milestones.
Renders a grid of clickable phase cards with progress indicators and completion badges. Allows navigation between different project phases.
frontend/src/components/ProgressIndicato: Simple component that displays a badge showing either 'Completado' with a check icon or 'Pendiente' with a circle icon based on completion status.
frontend/src/components/TaskCard.tsx: Displays individual task details including description, due date, day number, and editable internal notes. Provides edit button to open task dialog.
frontend/src/components/TaskDialog.tsx: Modal dialog wrapper for creating or editing tasks. Contains TaskForm component and handles open/close state.
frontend/src/components/TaskForm.tsx: Form for creating or editing tasks with phase, milestone, description, and due date fields. Filters milestone options based on selected phase and handles submission mutations.
frontend/src/constants/milestones.ts: Defines the complete 6-phase, 18-milestone project structure with detailed content, date ranges, and deliverables for a legal lead generation business plan. Includes phase and milestone data types and arrays.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state. Automatically recreates actor when identity changes and invalidates dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdsMetrics.ts: Hook for fetching and managing advertising metrics data. Provides query for all ads metrics and mutation for adding new monthly metrics (spend, leads, appointments, conversions).
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity storage, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useTasks.ts: Custom hook that manages tasks and milestones using React Query, providing queries for fetching data and mutations for adding/editing tasks, updating notes, and milestone progress.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm earth-tones color palette (avoiding blue/purple) for light and dark modes, including phase-specific colors.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdsDashboard.tsx: Dashboard page for tracking monthly advertising metrics (spend, leads, appointments, conversions) with a form to add new data and a table displaying calculated KPIs like cost-per-lead and conversion rates.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page displaying a 90-day flight plan with phase navigation, overall progress tracking, milestone sections with tasks, and a dialog for adding new tasks.
frontend/src/utils/adsCalculations.ts: Utility functions for calculating advertising metrics (cost per lead, appointment rate, conversion rate, cost per conversion) and formatting currency/percentage values.
frontend/src/utils/dateUtils.ts: Date utility functions for converting between backend Time format and JavaScript Dates, with a fixed start date of February 20, 2026, and helpers for calculating day numbers within a 90-day period.
frontend/src/utils/progressUtils.ts: Utility functions for calculating phase and overall progress based on milestone completion percentages, returning structured progress data with completed counts and average percentages.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file that defines custom color schemes using OKLCH color space (including primary, secondary, destructive, muted, accent, chart, and phase colors), border radius variables, custom animations for accordions, and includes typography, container queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state file documenting a Spanish-language 90-day lead generation dashboard for personal injury cases in Utah, structured in 6 phases with 18 milestones, tracking known issues with checkbox functionality and progress tracking that have persisted across versions 3-8.
